i18n.enTitle: Explain how to use AI agent! Procedures and precautions for delegating work
i18n.enSummary: Are you spending too much time checking your emails and researching materials every day, and putting off the work you should be thinking about? Using AI agents, it becomes possible to entrust these tasks as a series of tasks. However, if you suddenly delegate the entire task to someone else, there is a risk that the wrong information will be adopted or unintentionally sent. Starting with small tasks and knowing how to proceed by narrowing down your authority is a shortcut to continuing to use them safely.
